steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Lastly, we have Operator Bubble, the youngest of this batch of promoted operators.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Yeaahhh!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: (Stand still, Bubble. I know you're excited, but we can't have you stomping...)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ....Yeaahhh!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Ahem, atennnnn-shun!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Rhodes Island Trainee Operator Bubble! Present and accounted for!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Bubble, this is the moment you've been waiting for since you came onboard. Are you ready?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm super ready!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Alright, then. Operator Bubble, you have passed the regular operator exams.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: As a trainee operator, your abilities and performance have met the standards befitting a regular operator. With Dr. Kal'tsit's approval, Human Resources is executing your promotion to a regular Rhodes Island Operator.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: This here is your medal certifying it. Keep at it and let's see some more outstanding results on your next exams!
Bubble puffs out her tiny chest as the HR operator bends down to neatly pin the medal on her.
Bubble sneakily stands on her tiptoes in an attempt to make herself a bit taller, in hopes of looking just as tall as all the operators who seem to be doing such amazing things each and every day.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (I'm a proper operator now. I gotta hold myself to a higher standard. No more crybaby stuff. I'm on my best behavior.)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Just like Blaze... or Nearl. I gotta be a great operator who can help lotsa people!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: My papa's over five meters tall! He's covered head to toe in our tribal totem tattoos! When I was a kid, I followed right behind him all the time, but I could only see a little bit of the tattoos on the back of his legs!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I thought about what those tattoos were supposed to be. A painting? A weapon? Something else?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I asked Papa, but he just told me I'd figure it out when I become a warrior one day. When I finally stand on his shoulder, I'd be able to see it all.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But then, I found the answer myself! I'm the only one who knows it, too! It's... a secret map—!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte tastes exaggeration.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...Ahem! Nuh-uh!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Don't act like you know. In our tribe, tattoo maps are secret maps that only our braves can see, and I, Bubble, am a warrior of my tribe! I've received a mystical guidance!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I remember Midnight saying he got a mystical guidance once, too, but then I saw Orchid pulling his ear...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Focus! I'm not done yet! Following that guidance, I made my way to a secret training base. Then, there was a rumbling sound coming from behind. All of a sudden, there were, like, five hundred sandbeasts rushing at me!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I went for the mouth with one hand, grabbed its tail with the other, and sent it flying a hundred meters in one big swing!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Then, I plucked up a tree, did a big sweep, and all the needleflies behind me got smacked away!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Finally, with a sandbeast in my left hand and a needlefly in my right, riding on a five meter tall tuskbeast, I proudly charged into the gloompincers' nest and wiped the floor with them!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte knows that those animals wouldn't be living in the same region.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Like every warrior before me, I raised my weapon high and successfully completed my training as a brave! I saw my papa putting me on his shoulder and recognizing me as a new addition to his braves!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: But how did you see your papa holding you up...?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...Ahem! Okay. I didn't see it. I made it up...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: My papa hasn't recognized me as a brave yet, but I know I'll get there one day.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'll stand on his shoulder, and I will get my tattoos. They'll have a map to the next brave's trial!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Just like... that map.
A map with a yellow arrow is posted on the wall in a corner of the playroom. Bubble tries her hardest to stand on her tiptoes in an attempt to read its bottommost part.
A few days ago, she saw a bunch of busy operators passing around that map. Their faces were covered in ash and scars, and they all had a serious, solemn look. It was really badass.
But they never let Bubble join in when they're hurrying down the hallway. They always stop her with an anxious look: You're still young. Get clear!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Maybe this map is just like Papa's tattoos. It's a map to a secret mission that only awesome people can read?)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Papa wouldn't tell me what his tattoos are all about, and those older operators wouldn't let me help them, but I'm a full-fledged regular operator now. I can help.)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (And if I do help, they won't chase me away the next time there's a big mission, right?)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ahem, I know one more secret, and that's—this map. It's a map to a critical Rhodes Island mission!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That's our trial! Once we finish it, those awesome operators will see what we can do, and maybe they won't stop us the next time there's a critical mission.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Papa and Mama told me. Braves don't become true warriors until they go through trials that are too tough for anybody else!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I wanna try. Even if it's only for a little bit, I wanna go!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I—I want to become a Rhodes Island brave!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Whoa... Me too! I wanna become Rhodes Island's biggest brave!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm the biggest!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Me... Me too!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: ...Morte says he wants to try, too.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay, then have you guys heard any mystical guidances that only braves can hear?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Like, say, maybe shooting an arrow toward the east of the mountain will lead us to a treasure. Or like maybe there's a huge fowlbeast perched on a snowy mountain somewhere. Like they do in games!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I've been hearing a lot of knocking sounds in the hallway, and they sound really far away.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Definitely not Vulcan forging stuff, and it's also not the sound of my blades bumping into things. They're coming from the floor, and the pipes, even further down from Vulcan's den.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid's been telling me not to go to the lower decks. They're doing something really important there. But I saw all the cool operators going to the lower decks.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte says there's a burnt smell down in the lower decks, and he ate it all up.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay... Yeah, I have an idea, then...!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: They posted this map out of our reach on purpose, but we've already figured out its secret.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's... there's a secret critical mission here aboard Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That's the mystical guidance that only official braves can hear. All of you are regular operators, right?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Don't worry about it! As long as we work our hardest, as long as we finish a big mission on our own, they'll know that we actually have what it takes to help them and that we won't be a burden!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: We need to make our own critical mission team and hop onto the missions that they won't let us join!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: C'mon, let's go!

steps.name: Frantic HR Operator
steps.text: Bubble! And Kay...? Shamare and Popukar, too!

steps.name: Flustered HR Operator
steps.text: (Whispers) Aww... shucks. What are they doing here?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I... I'm training!

steps.name: Frantic HR Operator
steps.text: Oh, that's it? We're just here to get a couple pieces of equipment. We won't get in your way, will we?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Not at all! You wouldn't get in our way...

steps.name: Flustered HR Operator
steps.text: Then... Do you see that anti-shock pad there? What do you think? Big enough? It's like two meters long, isn't it...?

steps.name: Frantic HR Operator
steps.text: (Whispers) Let's go with that. Orchid told us to keep it from them. Let's wait till they're gone before we come to pick it up.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Do you need any help?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: If you need help, I'm real strong!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'm stronger!

steps.name: Flustered HR Operator
steps.text: Oh, no, that's okay. We can manage!

steps.name: Frantic HR Operator
steps.text: Yep, sure can. We'll take care of it on our own!

steps.name: Flustered HR Operator
steps.text: Alright, we're going now! Bye!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: They're usually pretty happy about me helping them all the way to their office. Why aren't they letting me help this time?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte, follow them.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: —Eep! Watch out!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: We just took this door frame down. You kids watch out. Don't get yourselves hurt!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's okay. I'm strong. I can help you!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Bubble, it's all loose screws and sheet metal here. Be careful...!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmph! That's nothing!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Where'd you get this broken doorframe?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Uh, hm... we found it during a routine inspection...

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: (Morte's back. This tastes like a lie.)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (I knew it! They're hiding something!)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It looks like something smashed into the doorframe, just like that time I passed out and woke up a while later...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Uh... This is just normal wear and tear...!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: (It's not.)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But this doorframe's really badly damaged. Right at the top, too.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (It must've been broken by someone really tall!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Where did you find this?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Um... On a lower deck.
Bubble glances at her little buddies.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (No mistaking it. Something big must've happened down there. They need our help. Let's go!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Got it. Thanks!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Nobody saw us, right?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: *cough*! There's so much dust! I can't breathe!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...*cough*...! The critical mission objective... the place where they need our help... *cough*...!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...should... be here!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: The strange knocking sound, and the cordon in front of the door. This is the objective!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then... Bubble, how are we gonna help them?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte says there are lots of different anxious tastes here filling his stomach right up.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: There's gotta be an ultra dangerous, ultra scary environment hiding behind this door! There might be lots of enemies and wild beasts, too!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But I think, as a brave, I gotta trust myself. I'm stronger than I know. I can do much more, and I can help a lot of people...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I know I can do this. I'm a regular operator now. I'll lead the way, just like the stories of the braves I told you all before!
Bubble the Brave clears her throat.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: 'Bubble the Brave donned her armor, raised her mighty weapon, and charged toward her objective.'

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: 'She knocked over a tree that blocked the road and crossed a long river, sped through the forest and the desert, and found the goal of her brave journey.'

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: 'Just like every warrior before her, she raised her weapon high!'

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: —Charge!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: 'Bubble the Brave has overcome her trial, and the whole tribe is cheering for her!'

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: 'The whole tribe is celebrating!'
The pipes at the end of the dark corridor are slammed hard and let out a creaking sound, followed by a cloud of dust filling the air and the spiraling pipes suddenly collapsing.
Bubble raises her head and looks at the dust-shrouded darkness before her expectantly.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: *cough*! *cough*...! What just dropped down?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: A medal?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Baddies?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: The instructor?
Aaaaagh—
A furball falls down from the ceiling, and the little heads gather round to see what exactly it is.
Who—
Whoknocked thesepipesdown? I'vebeeninspectingthisarea foralongtime. Thesepipesaresocomplicated it'sgonnatakemeforever justtoputtogether aproposal. Whotookthemalldown?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's over... *cough*!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Did we mess up?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: *cough*... Why is...? Shaw...!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Haaahhh!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Whoknockedallthesedown?

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Whodidit?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...Sorry, Shaw... I...

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Nonononono!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: WhatI'msayingis it'sperfect! Iwasgonnaask Engineeringtohelp demolishtheabandonedpipelines sincetheywereafirehazard. Theyweresocomplicated, butyoutorethemalldown inonego!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Didyouknock'emdown, Bubble?

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Youwereagreathelp!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Mybuttstillkindahurts, butthat'sfine. Westillhavelotsofpipes thatneedtearingdown, butthissavesus lotsoftime!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Whatkindofreward doyougirlswant? EverytimeIgivelectures, Ibringsome medalstogiveout. Howaboutthose?
Shaw pulls out a small, metallic medal. Each one has a thumbs-up etched on it.

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: You'reabunchof littlefirefightingwarriors, contributingtoRhodesIsland's firepreventionefforts!

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Thisisyourreward! Here, yougetamedal, yougetamedal, everybodygetsamedal!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: This mission...

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: Thanks, girls, buttherearestill moreplacesthat needtobeinspected. Youcanall headbacknow. I'llgetallthese removedpipestakenaway. Don'tcomeback beforethat'sdone.

steps.name: Shaw
steps.text: OnceI'mfinishedhere, I'lltellyourinstructor abouteverythingyou'vedone!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: So this isn't Rhodes Island's critical secret mission...?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Even though I'm a regular operator now, all I've done is... pitch in a little bit...
Bubble strokes the small medal that Shaw gave her.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Shaw was really thankful, but I wanna complete a real awesome mission...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I've been improving all this time, and I wanna show Papa how far I've come...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...I don't wanna be left out anymore... I wanna help everyone do even more awesome stuff... No, I can't. I'm a regular operator now. I can't cry!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: ...I want Papa to think that I'm a brave...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Shaw's so nice! I'll keep doing my best!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan's looking for me. I'm gonna show her the medal I got today!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Was that the critical mission that Bubble was talking about?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Morte just had dessert. It was sadness. I think Bubble's sad, because this didn't feel like a critical mission.

steps.name: Wall That Suddenly Appeared
steps.text: ...Bubble...?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But Shaw looked very happy, so we probably accomplished something, right?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh? How come Bubble's still inside?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Ow! I got knocked back, like a little fowlbeast flying away!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Why is there a wall? This wasn't here before.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: *sob*... Vulcan said not to hit my head or I'll turn stupid... What do I do?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Hold on, look at all the patterns on the wall... They're just like the patterns that Bubble told us about in her stories.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Shamare, you remember everything! I already forgot what she told us...

steps.name: Wall That Suddenly Appeared?
steps.text: You girls...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: There's another rumbling sound from above! Is this the critical mission Bubble talked about?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Do we need to knock this wall down to complete it?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Bubble, where are you? Is this wall the mission you were talking about?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Bubble—?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Bubble—!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: —Papa?!
The little heads look back at Bubble, who was all depressed just a moment ago.

steps.name: Team 140's
steps.text: ...Papa?!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: —Papa!
Bubble wants to throw the thing in her hand away to hop into the embrace of her papa who wouldn't have come to visit until a whole lot of days or even months or maybe years later.
But she also wants to show her medal to her papa, and so her hand reaches back to grab it.

This causes her left leg to trip over her right. She almost falls onto the ground bum first, but she has very good reflexes thanks to her training at Rhodes Island. She instinctively adjusts her posture to have her shield fall onto the ground—
But instead she falls onto a big hand that's firm yet soft to the touch.

steps.name: Team 140's
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Team 140's
steps.text: Bubble's papa is a moving wall...!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: *sob*... Papa...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Papa, why are you here so early...? *sob*...
Bubble's tears fall down her cheeks. She sniffles to shake them off as quick as she can.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (No, I can't. I'm a regular operator already. I can't be a crybaby anymore!)
She takes the medal that she treasures so much from her chest and raises it for Papa to see.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Papa, look! I got promoted yesterday! This is my medal. I'm a regular operator now!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: And this!
She points at the small medal that Papa likewise caught, but all of a sudden, she also feels kinda embarrassed about it.

Would Papa think that was a stupid little mission for babies? Would he think she isn't up to completing badass, awesome missions like the grown-ups, that she can't help anybody, and that she can't call herself a brave yet?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Err... actually, I guess maybe I'll show you next time!
But Papa keeps rubbing the two medals with a smile. The circular metallic pieces look so tiny in his big hands, but he seems to be looking at them with such admiration.
These tiny metal bits are nowhere close to covering the patterns on his palm, but they are more than enough to make him crack a smile.
It's almost like he's trying to see all his young daughter's hard work and growth in these two tiny medals.

steps.name: Bubble's Papa
steps.text: You earned both of these?

steps.name: Bubble's Papa
steps.text: That's my girl!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, Popukar! I knew I heard something strange down here...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Didn't I tell you to stay away from this place? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I didn't mean to... but this is where our critical mission is...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*, so there was no hiding it...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm very sorry, sir. I wanted to discuss throwing Bubble a surprise party, and I specifically told the girls to stay away, but they still found the place in the end...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Since we don't have a bed large enough for you, I was thinking of using the anti-shock pads they use for training as your mattress as well as widening the door frame, but it seems we got careless...
The Cerato warrior dismisses her apology with a wave and a smile. He bends down and picks up his tiny-as-ever daughter and raises her up high, before setting her down on his broad shoulder.

steps.name: Bubble's Papa
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I'm sure getting to see me so soon is a big enough surprise to her.
Ceobe looks up to find Bubble so very, very high up that she can touch the ceiling just by raising her hand. It reminds Ceobe of how valiant Bubble often said she looked in her stories.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: ...Bubble's just like those stories right now!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: 'Bubble the Brave stands proud, tall as a tree... in a full suit of armor!'

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Awesome...!

As Bubble sits on her papa's shoulder, the shield on her back just happens to form a pauldron. She remembers how when her siblings were first recognized as braves, they all sat on their parents' shoulders, just like this.
When she was little, all she could ever see, no matter how hard she craned her neck, would be a small fragment of all the totem tattoos on his body.
Papa always said that when the time came that she could stand on his shoulder, she would see the full picture of his tattoos. Now, she finally sees them in their entirety.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Papa, move your neck a little. I wanna see your tattoos!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I wanna see what they show!
The Cerato warrior leans his neck a bit to let his daughter see his latest tattoo.
In the large tribal totem, there is a small Cerato girl carrying a big, heavy shield, and charging forward.
She charges on, as if she will break through all the hurdles that lay in front of her, toward a boundless, limitless swath of land, free of any obstacles.
The 'map' that she saw when she was small is approaching completion. She is the one standing at the top of this mystical map. She is her papa's little pride.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Papa...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Am I your pride? I helped a lot of people, didn't I?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I am, right?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Right?!
